When  a large number  of  items  are  involved  in  a  provision,  the  value  represents  the  weighting  of  all
possible outcomes by their associated probabilities. The midpoint of the range is used when there are
possible rounds in the stacked range and every point in the range is the same as any other.
Probably the best estimate is the best estimate needed to settle the relationship when there is provision
for a single commitment. However, even in such a case, the municipality is considering other possible
outcomes.  If  other  possible  outcomes  are  higher  or  lower  than  the  most  likely  outcome,  the  best
estimate would be a higher or lower value than the most likely single outcome.
